name: Procurement / transaction activity
product_relevance_reason: A public contract award is one of the few transaction-class facts this portfolio can lawfully reach, and it bears on market activity, buyer existence and economic value — with the bounds Mission 1.20 established, since a published total includes options and renewals and is not what a buyer paid.

routes.note: TED publishes notices submitted by contracting authorities. It does not observe an award; it receives and publishes the document recording one.

routes.basis: reasoned from held evidence and the Mission 1.46 law
routes.note: A national portal carrying the same submitted notice is republishing one document. A different jurisdiction is a different population, not a second witness. NOT newly retrieved this mission, and recorded as reasoning from held evidence rather than as a first-party finding.

same_proposition_reason: The award is recorded once, by the authority, in one submitted document. Every publisher of that document is a distribution layer, which is the Mission 1.46 finding in a new domain.
commercial_purpose_note: TED's reuse position was established in Mission 1.45 and is not re-reviewed here.
unresolved_load_bearing_gaps: whether any party independently observes an award rather than republishing the notice — not investigated this mission
mission: 1.69 — Independent Product-Relevant Quantity Class Selection V1
